$doc: CC-ORTHO-SWEEP-ALL: generator rules and seed pairs handed to CC-SENSE-CUE (it owns the table, its status and the read API). Nothing here changes grading. kind true = identical sound in this voice; accent = differs for some speakers or in some voices, never accepted as a homophone.
status: missing: no generator yet (SENSE-CUE builds key_fr); rules and seeds staged

rules.description: rule-based grapheme-to-phoneme plus voice loopback; a dictionary is a check only
brin/brun, empreinte/emprunte: merged in Paris, distinct elsewhere; accent, no bonus, no acceptance (SENSE-CUE v1.2)
